timeline.text_cn: 重生时冷却时间从7秒缩短至3秒。

timeline.text_en: Cooldown on spawn reduced from 7 to 3 seconds.

timeline.text_cn: “竖直劈斩”范围加成从2.0米提高至2.5米。

timeline.text_en: Overhead swing bonus range increased from 2.0 to 2.5 meters.

timeline.text_cn: 横向挥剑伤害从45点降低至30点。
竖直劈斩伤害从120点降低至90点。
竖直劈斩伤害不变，依然是120点。
现在激活时会被动消耗能量。
现在对敌人的击退改为拉近敌人。
现在在蓄力时，瞄准指示也会向敌人显示。
现在不仅可以击中“斩仇”身前的敌人，也能击中她身后的敌人。

timeline.text_en: Now passively drains energy while active.
Now pulls enemies in instead of pushing them out.
Targeting indicator now visible to enemies while charging up.
Now hits behind Vendetta as well as in front.
Cooldown Reduction per Onslaught stack reduced to 3% (Down from 5%).

timeline.text_cn: 每层提供的移动速度加成从2%提升至3%。
最大持续时间从5.5秒延长至7.5秒。
每拥有一层[越战越勇]，获得5%生命汲取，冷却时间刷新速度加快5%。
[飞空斩击]伤害也会触发爆炸。
冷却时间缩减从0.7秒降低至0.5秒。
添加效果：用[锋锐剑气]造成伤害会使能量恢复速度额外加快50%，持续3秒。
基础能量恢复速度从50%降低至25%。
过量生命值上限从100点提高至200点。
现在所有伤害都可以触发，而不只是远程伤害。
原效果：格挡远程伤害后，[竖直劈斩]发射一道具有75%伤害的[锋锐剑气]。新效果：使用[飞空斩击]后，你的下一次帕拉蒂尼之牙[竖直劈斩]也会发射一道具有75%伤害的[锋锐剑气]。
原效果：即将阵亡时，临时复生，每叠加一次[越战越勇]便获得最大总生命值的20%，并变为限制状态。（90秒冷却时间）。新效果：即将阵亡时，变为限制状态并无法获得友方治疗，获得持续衰减的过量生命值，数值为你的最大总生命值，且使[越战越勇]叠加次数与生命汲取翻倍。
裂地重刃——稀有武器英雄物品
战意强化器——史诗技能英雄物品
技能生命汲取从10%提高至15%。
马尔齐亚的掌控——史诗生存英雄物品
飞空英姿——史诗生存英雄物品
添加效果：50点生命值，5%冷却时间缩减。

timeline.text_en: Movement speed boost per stack increased from 2% to 3%.
Maximum duration increased from 5.5 to 7.5 seconds.
"Gain 5% Lifesteal and your cooldowns refresh 5% faster for each Onslaught stack."
Soaring Slice damage also triggers the explosion.
Added "When you deal [Projected Edge] damage gain an additional 50% for 3s."
Base energy regeneration reduced to 25% (Down from 50%).
Now triggers off of all damage instead of just Ranged damage.

Reworked from "After blocking ranged damage, Overhead swing shoots a [Projected Edge] with 75% damage" to "After using [Soaring Slice], your next [Palatine Fang] Overhead Slash also shoots a [Projected Edge] with 75% damage".

Reworked from "Before dying, temporarily comeback to life with 20% Max Life per each [Onslaught] stack and become hindered. (90s Cooldown)" to "If you would die, instead become Hindered and prevent ally healing, gain decaying Overhealth equal to your Max Life, and double your [Onslaught] stack and Lifesteal."
Crator Creator - Rare Hero Weapon Item
Onslaught Amplifier - Epic Hero Ability Item
Marzia's Mastery - Epic Hero Survival Item
Up and Over - Epic Hero Survival Item

timeline.text_cn: 通过造成治疗和伤害获得的资金提高5%。

timeline.text_en: Increased Currency gain from Healing and Damage by 5%.
Health increased from 175 to 200. (Total health increased from 250 to 275.)

timeline.text_cn: 每层效果的移动速度加成从4%降低至2%。
timeline.metric: 每层效果的移动速度加成

timeline.text_cn: “竖直劈斩”范围加成从2.5米降低至2.0米。
通过造成伤害和提供治疗获得的角斗资金提高5%。
“旋风疾步”在额外持续时间内的伤害从50%提高至75%。
“旋风疾步”再次激活伤害从50%提高至75%。
免费“锋锐剑气”伤害从50%提高至75%。
微型“斩地巨剑”伤害提高效果从25%提高至50%。

timeline.text_en: Movement speed per stack reduced from 4% to 2%.
Overhead swing bonus range reduced from 2.5 to 2.0 meters.
Currency from damage and healing increased by 5%.
Whirlwind Dash Damage during additional duration increased to 75% (Up from 50%).
Whirlwind Dash reactivation damage increased to 75% (Up from 50%).
Free Projected Edge damage increased to 75% (Up from 50%).
Mini Sundering Blade damage increased to 50% increased damage (Up from 25%).
Vendetta's camera is always in 3rd person, with her aim being totally separate from the player's.
Vendetta will automatically lock on to nearby enemies, facing them no matter how the player moves.
Press Interact to lock on to the nearest enemy your crosshair is aiming at.

timeline.text_cn: “斩仇”的镜头始终处于第三人称，而她的瞄准和玩家的瞄准完全分离。
“斩仇”会自动锁定附近的敌人，无论玩家如何移动，她始终面朝敌人。
按下互动键可锁定离你准星所瞄方向最近的敌人。

lines_cn: 从主要威能改为了次级威能。
每次旋转的伤害从35降低至30。
从次级威能改为了主要威能。
竖直劈斩的生命汲取从30%提高至40%。

lines_en: Damage per spin reduced from 35 to 30.

timeline.text_en: Overhead swing damage reduced from 130 to 120.
Bug fix - Overhead swing can now be affected by horizontal knockback while launching downward.
Before dying, temporarily come back to life with 15% Max Life per each [Onslaught] stack and become hindered. (90s Cooldown)
[Onslaught]'s maximum stack increases by 1 after earning 2 Eliminations, up to 3.
After using [Soaring Slice], holding Overhead swing in air can channel level 1 [Sundering Blade] with 25% increased damage.
After blocking ranged damage, Overhead swing shoots a [Projected Edge] with 50% damage.
[Warding Stance] energy regenerates energy regenerates now even while blocking at 75% rate. For every [Projected Edge] fired, reduce [Whirlwind Dash] and [Soaring Slice] cooldown by 0.7s.
[Warding Stance] has 50% increased energy regeneration rate.
After blocking ranged damage, remove [Warding Stance] move speed penalty. Vendetta's next swing becomes an overhead swing.
[Whirlwind Dash] to continue spinning up to 3s for 50% damage after the initial spin.
After [Whirlwind Dash] is finished, it can be reactivated within 3s for 50% damage.
After using [Soaring Strike], overhead strike and [Sundering Blade] gives 30% of damage as temporary Overhealth, up to 100.
Using [Soaring Slice] gives 35% of missing life as Overhealth for 10s.
[Projected Edge] explodes on enemy hit, dealing 20 (AP) damage to enemies within 4m.
Crater Creator - Rare Weapon Hero Item
Performing an Overhead swing mid-air drags the hit enemy down to the ground along with Vendetta, dealing 30 (WP) damage on land.
Scaled Steel - Epic Weapon Hero Item
Chimera Cross - Rare Ability Hero Item
After blocking damage, gain 15% Ability Power for 5s.
Warrior's Shout - Rare Ability Hero Item
Using [Whirlwind Dash] gives 10% of max life as Overhealth to all allies within 9m.
Talon Trinket - Rare Ability Hero Item
For each enemy hit by [Sundering Blade], reduce [Whirlwind Dash]'s Cooldown by 1s.
Onslaught Amplifier - Epic Ability Hero Item
Gain 5% Ability Power for every [Onslaught] stack. 12000 Cost
Marzia's Mastery - Epic Ability Hero Item
[Soaring Slice] heals all allies within line of sight for 150% of the damage dealt over 2s.
Ricochet Razor - Epic Ability Hero Item
Colosseo Coin - Rare Survival Hero Item
The last player to land a killing blow on you becomes a target. Eliminate the target to gain 200 extra Stadium Cash and reset cooldowns.
Braced Blade - Rare Survival Hero Item
Gain 1 [Onslaught] stack for every 50 damage absorbed with [Warding Stance].
After deflecting a melee attack, gain 2% Ultimate Charge.
Duelist's Draught - Epic Survival Hero Item
Gain 15% damage reduction if there is only 1 enemy within 6m.
Antonio's Lesson - Epic Survival Hero Item
Gain 50% damage reduction during dashing using [Whirlwind Dash] or [Soaring Slice].
Vicious Vow - Epic Survival Hero Item
While channeling [Sundering Blade], gain 25 (AP) Overhealth every second, up to 50 (AP).

timeline.text_cn: “飞空斩击”现在在重生时会进入冷却（在死斗模式中或在被复活时不适用）。
每次旋转的伤害从40降低至35。

timeline.text_en: Soaring Slice now starts on cooldown when respawning (does not apply when Resurrected or in Death Match)
Damage reduced from 40 to 35 per spin.
Horizontal swing damage reduced from 50 to 45.
Overhead swing recovery can now be interrupted by Warding Stance
Fixed a bug with launching enemies downward with the overhead not working consistently against flying targets
Raging Storm perk recovery time reduced from 0.4 to 0.25 seconds
Recovery time for Whirlwind Dash and Soaring Slice reduced from 0.35 to 0.2 seconds
Recovery time reduced from 0.25 to 0.1 seconds
Weapon throw range increased from 14 to 15 meters

timeline.text_cn: 帕拉蒂尼之牙竖直劈斩、“旋风疾步”和“锋锐剑气”的恢复时间缩短15%。
弹道速度从每秒33米提高至37米。
最大投掷距离从16米缩短至14米。

timeline.text_en: Reduced recovery times of Palatine Fang overhead, Whirlwind Dash, and Projected Edge by about 15%
Projectile speed increased from 33 to 37 meters per second
Max throw distance reduced from 16 to 14 meters
